insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (document mentions: "Sum Insured Opted for and for which the premium is paid")

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Applicable for diseases other than Disability / HIV/AIDS: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with insurer.
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases – Code Excl 01
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases and their direct complications are not covered for the first 36 months of continuous coverage. Claims for PEDs become payable only after you complete 3 years without a break.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 2. Speciﬁed disease/procedure waiting period – Code Excl 02
good.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are not covered for the first 24 months of continuous coverage. You can claim for these only after completing 2 years on the policy.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 3. 30-day waiting period – Code Excl 03
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered in the first 30 days from the policy start date, while accidents are covered (if otherwise covered). This mainly affects claims made soon after buying the policy.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Pre-Hospitalization medical expenses incurred for a period not exceeding 30 days prior to the date of hospitalization...
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 30 days before hospitalization are covered if related to the same hospitalization. Costs before this 30-day window may not be payable.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Post Hospitalization medical expenses incurred for a period of 60 days from the date of discharge from the hospital...
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days after discharge are covered if related to the hospitalization. Follow-up care beyond 60 days may not be covered.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Room, Boarding, Nursing Expenses all inclusive as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home up to maximum of 1% of the sum insured per day.
bad.explanation: Room rent (including boarding and nursing) is capped at 1% of the sum insured per day. Choosing a room above this limit can increase your out-of-pocket costs and may reduce payable hospital bills.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: Expenses incurred on treatment of Cataract is covered up to Rs.40,000/- per each eye in one policy year.
bad.explanation: Cataract treatment is limited to ₹40,000 per eye per policy year. If the hospital bill is higher, you will have to pay the difference yourself.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: Coverage for Modern treatment... will be covered... up to 50% of Sum Insured, speciﬁed in the policy schedule, during the policy period:
bad.explanation: Modern treatments are covered only up to 50% of the sum insured during the policy period. Expensive advanced procedures may leave a significant shortfall even when you have sum insured available.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Each and every claim under the Policy shall be subject to a Co-payment of 20% applicable to claim amount admissible and payable as per the terms and conditions of the Policy.
bad.explanation: A mandatory 20% co-payment applies to every claim on the admissible amount. You will pay 1/5th of each covered bill from your pocket, which can be costly in large hospitalizations.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Such associated medical expenses do not include Cost of pharmacy and consumables, Cost of implants and medical devices and Cost of diagnostics.
bad.reference: Definitions > Specific Definitions > Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: Pharmacy/consumables, implants/medical devices, and diagnostics are excluded from “associated medical expenses” as per this definition. This can increase out-of-pocket spending if these items are billed separately and not covered elsewhere in the policy.

unclear.name: Restore Benefit
unclear.quote: If during the period stated in the Policy Schedule... the Company will indemnify... but not exceeding sum insured stated in the Policy schedule.
unclear.reference: Coverage > 2. COVERAGE (no restore/recharge wording found in provided pages)
unclear.explanation: The provided text only states indemnity up to the sum insured and does not clearly mention any restore/recharge of sum insured. You should confirm from the full wording/schedule whether any restore benefit exists and its conditions.

unclear.name: No-Claim Bonus
unclear.quote: Renewal of policy: The policy shall ordinarily be renewable except on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation by the Insured Person.
unclear.explanation: The quoted renewal clause does not mention any no-claim bonus or increase in sum insured for claim-free years. You should check the benefits section or schedule to confirm whether an NCB is offered and how it changes after a claim.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless facility can be availed only in networked Hospitals. For details of Networked Hospitals, the insured may visit www.starhealth.in...
unclear.reference: Conditions > Claim Settlement > B (Documents for Cashless Treatment)
unclear.explanation: Cashless treatment is available only at network hospitals, but the number of hospitals is not stated here. You should verify whether your preferred hospitals are in the insurer’s current network before buying.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
